d.g: Etomidate, as an unlawfully-used controlled drug mixed in e-cigarette liquid.
d.x: Kpods – vape juice that is usually mixed with etomidate, an anaesthetic used in some non-surgical procedures – are a growing scourge in Singapore, according to some social service agencies here.

Kpod.e: From K (“ketamine”) + pod, referring to effects similar to those of ketamine abuse.

d.x: In an interview with Jacobin to be published later this year, veteran KPO activist Theodor Bergmann tells of Heinrich Adam, prewar KPO member and mechanic at the Zeiss optics factory in Jena who joined the SED in hopes of realizing socialist unity.

KPO.e: Borrowed from German KPO (“Kommunistische Partei Deutschlands (Opposition)”).
